roadmap.title: Choose the intro rescues
roadmap.description: Pick one intro path: rescue both captives for Damsels in distress, or abandon both for Not my problem. Switching needs a new game.

roadmap.title: Fairy, Pepper and the household
roadmap.description: Save before the first Fairy visit and before the Hive mission, then finish Fairy's path, Pepper's offer and the household scenes.

roadmap.title: Shani's Zone expedition and the Hive
roadmap.description: Complete the Zone trip, replay it for the haunted apartment and the Julia stay, and take the Hive Queen's offer.

roadmap.title: Overpass and palace
roadmap.description: Save before the highway settlement, take the kind route, then reload for the harsh one.

steps.text: Play through the opening story until the introduction ends.

achievements.description: You saved both the mutant and the raider during the intro
achievements.summary: Save the mutant and the raider in the introduction.

guide.context: Mutually exclusive with Not my problem. The choices cannot be reversed once made, so earning both needs two separate new games.

steps.text: Start a new game, picking the full-experience and all-options settings.
With the mutant, choose @mechanic{Disarm her} twice, then @mechanic{Ask to know more} and @mechanic{Let her make up for it}.
Head into the ruins on the right, try every dialogue option, and give up the artifact to free the elf (the @mechanic{Hand over} choice).
On the first @loc{Travel} after the intro, choose @mechanic{Save the raider}.

achievements.description: You saved neither the mutant nor the raider during the intro
achievements.summary: Leave the mutant and the raider unsaved in the introduction.

guide.context: Mutually exclusive with Damsels in distress. Start a separate new game for it.

steps.text: Start a new game. In the mutant scene, pick @mechanic{Take her out} and @mechanic{Kill her}. Continue with @mechanic{Use her} and @mechanic{Hydrate her}, and end with @mechanic{Toss her away and leave}.
Head into the ruins on the right, try every dialogue option, and choose @mechanic{Walk away}.
On the first @loc{Travel} after the intro, choose @mechanic{Leave her to her fate}.

achievements.description: Completed the Zone while playing as Shani
achievements.summary: Finish the Zone expedition as Shani.

steps.text: After the Fairy scenes, choose @mechanic{Switch to Shani} in the Master Bedroom and agree to team up (@mechanic{Okay, we can try}).
Leave the bunker and follow Abrax's map. At Julia's place, choose @mechanic{Spend some time with her} and @mechanic{Spend more time together}, then @mechanic{Continue the mission}.
At the skeleton, take a look, investigate before climbing down, read the note, and leave the bunker.
Find the Scout and leave the Zone. When the Scout talks, choose the @mechanic{Play along} line, then @mechanic{Respond}. Follow the prompts in the next cutscene.

achievements.displayName: Remember me, but let me go
achievements.description: You have taken too much advantage of Julia's hospitality while playing as Shani
achievements.summary: Stay with Julia too long during the Shani expedition.

guide.context: Make a manual save at Julia's place before sleeping; if you continue the mission instead, reload it.

steps.text: Switch to Shani, leave the bunker, and follow Abrax's map. Pick the @mechanic{Why would you stay here?} line to reach Julia.
Choose @mechanic{Spend some time with her}, then @mechanic{Spend more time together}, and save.
Choose @mechanic{Go to sleep} instead of continuing the mission.

achievements.description: You have escaped from the haunted apartment while playing as Shani
achievements.summary: Escape the haunted apartment as Shani.

guide.context: Any save from before @mechanic{Switch to Shani} works if you already finished the Zone trip.

steps.text: Switch to Shani, leave the bunker, and choose the optional @mechanic{Investigate the apartment}, then @mechanic{Head inside}.
Check the kitchen, bedroom and entrance, going back after each. Then return and check the radio, read the note, and turn the radio off when it plays.
Approach the body, check the radio and the note, and turn the radio off again. Check the bedroom.
Choose @mechanic{Run out}, then @mechanic{Check the note} and @mechanic{Turn it off}.

achievements.description: Fairy has joined your home and you helped her recover
achievements.summary: Help Fairy recover after she joins your home.

guide.context: Mutually exclusive with Ignorance is bliss. The first visits after the rescue set her path, so save before your first Fairy visit and reload that save for the other achievement.

steps.text: Save before your first Fairy visit. From @loc{Basement}, choose @mechanic{Visit Fairy} and communicate gently, ending with @mechanic{You are under no pressure here}.
On later visits, choose @mechanic{See to her needs}: get her attention first, hand over what she needs, and tell her to rest. Let her eat on her own and give her a proper bed.
At the bath visit, send Emilia away and take over, then massage her head.
After the grocery scene, go back to the @loc{Basement} and choose @mechanic{Try talking to her again}. The achievement unlocks before the Asani visit.

achievements.description: Fairy has joined your home and you didn't help her recover
achievements.summary: Let Fairy join your home without helping her recover.

guide.context: Mutually exclusive with To hell and back. Save before your first Fairy visit and reload it to switch. A mixed route earns neither.

steps.text: Save before your first Fairy visit. From @loc{Basement}, choose @mechanic{Visit Fairy}, inspect her, and tell her your body will do just fine.
On later visits, tell her to be ready to serve, treat her roughly, make her eat off the floor, and give her a pet bed.
At the bath visit, send Emilia away, take over, and remind her of her place.
Visit her again and choose @mechanic{Tell me, who's your Master}. If the achievement hasn't unlocked, keep visiting her and use every option.

achievements.description: You have taken control of the overpass and improved their living conditions
achievements.summary: Take control of the overpass and improve the residents' living conditions.

guide.context: Mutually exclusive with Let them eat cake. Save before leaving for the highway settlement.

steps.text: Travel to the highway settlement and speak politely: say you are there for the Queen, hear their offer, and warn that the Queen will not be pleased.
Speak to the medic, search the shack, and talk the father into letting his son work there.
Help each resident: let the bald woman speak for the community, promise the man his own slave, promise the woman an improved system, and ask Wick about his demands.
Return to the medic and ask whether they will keep their word.
Later, open the Raider's Camp mission table and start @mechanic{Sekhmet's Legion (Part 1)}. Be supportive when asked: praise their spirit and sympathize with what happened to her.
Walk around the settlement using its arrow, then return home. The achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: You have taken control of the overpass and exploited the residents
achievements.summary: Take control of the overpass and exploit the residents.

guide.context: Mutually exclusive with People pleaser, which you can earn first in the same run. Reload the save made before the highway settlement.

steps.text: Travel to the highway settlement and choose @mechanic{I need to see your boss}, then @mechanic{You're going to regret this}.
Speak to the medic, search the shack, and talk the father into letting his son work there.
Exploit each resident: make the bald woman's skills available to everyone, threaten the man over Kitty, make the woman distribute water on merit, and plot against Wick.
Return to the medic and ask whether they will keep their word.

Later, at the @loc{Raider's Camp}, walk around the settlement and choose @mechanic{Peek inside}, @mechanic{Try out her...}, then send him out, stop him, and tell him to keep it up. Click the last arrow.
Visit the Palace, say the task was dangerous and she almost died, and go through both options.

achievements.description: Listened to Ivy's story of her tower
achievements.summary: Listen to Ivy's story of her tower.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{The Hive (Part 2)}. Then visit Ivy and open her entries, try every option, read entry #13, back out twice, and shut the screen down.
Visit the lab and gym, then go to sleep. Visit the lab again and request a hand massage.
Go Home and open the @loc{Master Bedroom}. Ask Igor and his girlfriend over, then pick @mechanic{Yes, tomorrow is good}.
Choose @loc{Travel}, then @mechanic{Visit Yuna}.

achievements.description: You have accepted the Hive Queen's offer

guide.context: Save before opening The Hive (Part 2). If you pick the other lines, reload it.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Mutants} mission table and start @mechanic{The Hive (Part 2)}.
Choose @mechanic{Agree}, @mechanic{Go with her}, then @mechanic{I stopped counting...}.

guide.context: Make a manual save right before this.

steps.text: Save before opening @mechanic{The Hive (Part 1)}. After it, take her back to base and visit the lab.
Pick @mechanic{You live and learn, right?}, then give her the go-ahead with the line that starts @mechanic{Alright then}.
At the @loc{Palace}, ask about Sharifa and answer that it is elegant and alluring.
Choose @mechanic{Approach her}.

achievements.description: Emilia, Fairy and Kateryna have joined your household
achievements.summary: Have Emilia, Fairy and Kateryna all join your household.

steps.text: Invite Igor and Kateryna from the @loc{Master Bedroom} early in the story, and keep Fairy at home.
Have the Ivy and Fangs conversations: ask whether Fangs needs help again, and say goodbye to Ivy.
In @loc{Shani's Bedroom}, choose @mechanic{Of course}, then @mechanic{Look at your wife}.

achievements.description: You became more intimate with Shani

steps.text: In @loc{Shani's Bedroom}, choose @mechanic{Yes}, then @mechanic{Look down}. Say you have restrained yourself because her training is unfinished, then ask what's wrong.
Choose @mechanic{You are beautiful}, then @mechanic{Caress her neck}. Finish by joining hands and admitting you didn't really listen.

achievements.description: You have discussed Shani's findings with Abrax

steps.text: After the highway settlement choices, go to the @loc{Palace}, choose @mechanic{Planning work}, then @mechanic{Take the offer} and @mechanic{Give me a twirl}.
Go to @loc{Decayed}, describe the cylinder, choose @mechanic{The remains of a dead civilization}, then @mechanic{Why would I...}.
